question: Why were the V2O5-coated NiTi wires strained beyond 10%?
rendered: The excerpts do not mention the V2O5-coated NiTi wires being strained beyond 10%. In fact, they state that tensile deformations beyond 10% were not performed to avoid delamination of the coating from the wire surface.
